summary: Bill Wood, 47, of Denver tumbled about 150 ft on a snowfield roughly 700 ft below Cathedral Peak's summit, injuring his ankle; he activated a SPOT emergency beacon at 7:45 a.m.; Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers and a medical helicopter dispatched from Frisco located him and a companion at 13,200 ft on the peak's east face and airlifted him to the hospital
location: Cathedral Peak, east face at 13,200 ft
notes: Date inferred: article published Thu 2019-07-25 reports the incident on "Sunday", i.e. 2019-07-21. MRA reached the party at 11:38 a.m.
